question: Which of the following locations receives the most rainfall in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mawsynram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mawsynram** is known to receive the highest rainfall in India.
 
• This village is located in the East Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya.
 
• Mawsynram holds the Guinness World Record for the highest average annual rainfall.</li&g
